# Day 6 -- Statistical Models (SARIMAX + ETSModel)

**Generated by** `src/evaluation/run_statistical.py`. 
Every number is produced by running the pipeline -- none is asserted.

All five candidates (3 baselines + 2 statistical) were run in a SINGLE 
`run_walk_forward` call on the identical 65 folds, so common support is 
computed across the whole comparison rather than within each family.

---

## 1. Pre-registered specifications and the evidence behind them

Specifications were selected ONCE from diagnostics on the development portion 
(pos 0..705); the 60-observation holdout was never touched. Coefficients are then 
refit at every one of the 65 fold origins -- the specification is fixed, the 
parameters are not.

| Target | Family | Specification | Selection evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Children in HHS Care | SARIMA | `(2, 1, 2)(0, 1, 1, 5)` | AIC-best was (2,1,2)(1,1,1,5) at 8177.8; this scores 8179.4 (delta-AIC 1.66, inside the 2-point indistinguishability band) and is the BIC optimum. Practical-equivalence rule selects the simpler model. 72/72 candidates converged. |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | SARIMA | `(0, 1, 2)(0, 1, 1, 5)` | AIC (6351.1) and BIC (6369.3) agree outright. 72/72 converged. |
| Children in HHS Care | ETS | additive error, damped additive trend, additive seasonal (m=5) | AIC and BIC both select this specification. |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | ETS | additive error, no trend, additive seasonal (m=5) | AIC a dead heat with additive trend (6914.82 vs 6914.74, delta 0.08); BIC prefers no trend (6955.3 vs 6964.2). Practical equivalence selects the simpler model. |

`d=1` and `m=5` were fixed at Day 3 (ADF/KPSS; Kruskal-Wallis p<1e-5). `D=1` is 
evidence-driven: the seasonal ACF at lag 5 decays slowly (HHS Care +0.628 at lag 5, 
+0.493 at lag 10), and one seasonal difference flips it to -0.321/-0.137 while lowering 
the standard deviation from 128.6 to 111.0. A negative seasonal ACF after seasonal 
differencing is the classic seasonal-MA signature -- which is why `Q=1` is selected 
for both targets, independently, by the grid.

Multiplicative ETS components were excluded on evidence, not taste: 
`Children discharged from HHS Care` reaches 0 (2025-11-30) and multiplicative forms are undefined at zero.

## 6. Does the training-window cap matter now?

At Day 5 the answer was no, and provably so: all three baselines read only the 
tail of the training window, so truncating its start could not change their 
forecasts. SARIMAX and ETSModel estimate parameters from the WHOLE window, so 
this is the first stage where the cap can bite. Measured:

| target | model | comparable_rows | identical | differing | median_abs_diff | max_abs_diff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Children discharged from HHS Care | exponential_smoothing | 195 | 168 | 27 | 0.0 | 5.6 |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | sarima | 195 | 168 | 27 | 0.0 | 27.648 |
| Children in HHS Care | exponential_smoothing | 195 | 165 | 30 | 0.0 | 190.902 |
| Children in HHS Care | sarima | 195 | 165 | 30 | 0.0 | 184.762 |
